an3.57:1.1: atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe…
an3.57:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an3.57:1.3: ‘sutaṃ me taṃ bho gotama’ samaṇo gotamo evamāha :
an3.57:1.4: mayhameva dānaṃ dātabbaṃ, nāññesaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ,
an3.57:1.5: mayhameva sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ, nāññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ,
an3.57:1.6: mayhameva dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ, nāññesaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ,
an3.57:1.7: mayhameva sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ, nāññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalanti.’
an3.57:1.8: ye te bho gotama evamāhaṃsu: samaṇo gotamo evamāha:
an3.57:1.12: mayhameva sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ, nāññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalanti.
an3.57:1.13: kacci te bhoto gotamassa vuttavādino? na ca bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti? dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākaronti? na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati?
an3.57:2.5: na me te vuttavādino. abbhācikkhanti ca pana maṃ te asatā abhūtena.
an3.57:2.6: yo kho vaccha paraṃ dānaṃ dadantaṃ vāreti, so tiṇṇaṃ antarāyakaro hoti, tiṇṇaṃ pāripanthiko.
an3.57:2.8: dāyakassa puññantarāyakaro hoti, paṭiggāhakānaṃ lābhantarāyakaro hoti. pubbeva kho panassa attā khato ca hoti upahato ca.
an3.57:2.9: yo kho vaccha paraṃ dānaṃ dadantaṃ vāreti, so imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ antarāyakaro hoti, tiṇṇaṃ pāripanthiko.
an3.57:3.1: ahaṃ kho pana vaccha evaṃ vadāmi:
an3.57:3.2: ‘yepi te candanikāya vā oligalle vā pāṇā, tatrapi yo thālidhovanaṃ vā sarāvadhovanaṃ vā chaḍḍeti.
an3.57:3.3: ye tattha pāṇā, te tena yāpentū’ti. tato nidānampāhaṃ vaccha puññassa āgamaṃ vadāmi.
an3.57:3.5: api cāhaṃ vaccha sīlavato dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ vadāmi, no tathā dussīle. so ca hoti, pañcaṅgavippahīṇo pañcaṅgasamannāgato.
an3.57:4.2: kāmacchando pahīṇo hoti, byāvyāpādo pahīṇo hoti, thīnamiddhaṃ pahīṇaṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahīṇaṃ hoti, vicikicchā pahīṇā hoti.
an3.57:5.2: asekkhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekkhena samādhikkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekkhena paññākkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekkhena vimuttikkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekkhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgato hoti.
an3.57:5.4: iti pañcaṅgavippahīṇe pañcaṅgasamannāgate dinnaṃ mahapphalanti vadāmīti.
